name: Mother Morel
lines: “The forest remembers every spore. The Variants are grinding up its memory to make a record shine.”
win: “The forest thanks you. It will not say so; it is a forest. The Psychic Badge is yours.”
hint: Mother Morel’s Psychic team is level 46–48. Steel and Dragon Billies shrug off Psychic moves.

seat.title: Psychic Badge · 7 of 8
seat.rewardText: 3 Bailouts, 4 Gold Coins and 2 Platinum Coins
seat.unlockText: Tanglewild Jungle, east of Capshade Town, is open.
